purpose: Apply for the grant of a compulsory licence under a patent, stating the patent particulars, the grounds relied upon, and the documentary evidence of the applicant's interest.

layout.notes: Two-column form: left column carries the numbered instructions (1-5); right column carries the running application with inline blanks and superscript markers. Fields sharing a presentation.group belong on the same printed line.

sections.title: Name, address and nationality of the applicant(s).
sections.description: Instruction 1: name, address and nationality of the applicant(s).

autofill.derivation: Choose 'I' for a single applicant, 'We' for multiple, from the applicant count in uploaded documents.

fields.label: Name, address and nationality of the applicant(s)
fields.helpText: Full name (family/principal name first), complete address incl postal index no./code and state, and nationality. The applicant for a compulsory licence is usually not the patentee.

validation.message: Enter the applicant's name, address and nationality.

sections.title: Patent Subject to the Application
sections.description: Pre-printed: 'hereby apply for the grant of a compulsory licence under Patent No. ...... dated ...... granted to ...... for which the patentee is ...... on the following grounds, namely : ......'

fields.text: hereby apply for the grant of a compulsory licence under Patent No.

validation.message: Enter the party to whom the patent was granted.

fields.label: Grounds
fields.helpText: Sections 84(1), 91, 92(1) and 92A each provide distinct grounds; state the grounds relied upon.

validation.message: State the grounds on which the compulsory licence is sought.

fields.text: I/We declare that the facts and matters stated herein are true to the best of my/our knowledge, information and belief.

sections.title: Documentary Evidence of Interest
sections.description: Pre-printed: 'The details of documentary evidence in support of my/our interest and the grounds stated above are given below (a) ...... (b) ...... (c) ......'

fields.text: The details of documentary evidence in support of
interest and the grounds stated above are given below

fields.label: Documentary evidence
fields.helpText: List each document relied upon, as printed items (a), (b), (c).

validation.message: List at least one document in support.

sections.title: Address for Service in India
sections.description: Instruction 3: complete address incl postal code and state along with telephone and fax number(s).

fields.label: My/Our address for service in India
fields.helpText: Must be an address in India. Include postal index no./code, state, and telephone and fax number(s).

validation.message: Enter an address for service in India.

sections.title: To be signed by the applicant(s) or by his authorised registered patent agent.

autofill.derivation: Default to the preparation / signing date; editable.

sections.title: Name of the natural person who has signed.

fields.label: Name of the natural person who has signed

validation.message: Enter the full name of the natural person who signed.

fields.text:
To
The Controller of Patents,
The Patent Office,
at

autofill.derivation: Jurisdictional patent office based on the applicant's address or the office recorded on the patent.

attachments.label: Certified copies of the documentary evidence of interest
attachments.note: Instruction 2: certified copies of the documents are to be enclosed in duplicate.

notes: Note. - For fee: See First Schedule.
Note. - Strike out whichever is not applicable.
Certified copies of the documents are to be enclosed in duplicate (instruction 2).
Sections 84(1), 91, 92(1) and 92A each provide distinct grounds; the grounds remain free text and user-controlled.

printedHeader.statute: THE PATENTS ACT, 1970 (39 of 1970) and THE PATENTS RULES, 2003
printedHeader.subject: APPLICATION FOR COMPULSORY LICENCE
